verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say it auto-detects NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs and downloads the matching backend, so it runs models across several GPU vendors with vendor-specific acceleration. The support rests on a single doc line, with no detail on which kernels or backend builds each vendor gets. missing for 10: explicit naming of vendor kernels/backends (e.g., CUDA, ROCm, SYCL/Vulkan), per-vendor configuration or override docs, independent hands-on corroboration of GPU acceleration performance.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: LocalAI automatically detects your system's GPU capabilities (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the appropriate backend.
Distributed nodes: Add GPU worker nodes that self-register with a frontend coordinator
